data.reason: Two bookkeeping errors in the plan, both mine, both named by the triage at record 17. The solution record's changes list does not name CLAUDE.md or docs/tickets/README.md, which are where a new ticket is registered, so slice_files reports them as changed by no slice. And the regression at record 14 ran before the Outcome was written, so the fingerprint check sees a tree that moved after the tests that passed: the Outcome goes in before the regression, not after it. Amending the plan and reordering, not arguing with either check.
